title: 第17章 偶遇第18章 离开
lines: 埃莉诺在面对陌生人的时候会十分紧张，以至于说不出话来。
用现代话来讲，就是社恐。
她并不是一开始就如此，原本是个正常的孩子，只是在成长的过程和朋友缺少交流。
然后演变为和陌生人交流觉得累，到了如今已经开始有些社恐了。
但就从她可以和朋友一起探测地下城来看，埃莉诺的社恐还没有到可怕的地步。
在埃莉诺调整好状态后，早就不耐烦的卡尔斯立刻前往了地下城。
原本的安排是卡尔斯确定怪物数量，埃莉诺描绘地下城结构示意图。
以两人的水平很快就可以完成的，但是他们发现了奇怪的地方：怪物的数量比正常范围小。
这不是什么好事。
要么是怪物之间发生了巨量的吞噬行为，要么是有人在大量杀宰怪物。
前者说明有某种高级怪物生成，后者说明这里有某个高危存在。
无论是哪种，对于他们来说都有不小的危险。
埃莉诺当即建议返回学院，而卡尔斯在探测了怪物水平之后，认为即使有更高级的怪物也是他们能够应付的。
于是两人发生了争执，说是争执不是很准确，毕竟以埃莉诺的性格也不会跟别人吵。
主要是卡尔斯在争辩，没有完成任务就返回学校对于他来说是一种耻辱。
卡尔斯讲到一半，决定不再费口舌，直接离开，独自探查去了。
埃莉诺追不上，再加上地下城结构没有探明，两人很快就找不到对方了。
埃莉诺只好寻找出口，准备寻求增援。
然后她就听到了人类的声音，激动的喊着什么“变了！”
“终于变了！”
什么的。
然后就是现在的局面：格林抱着露姆看着埃莉诺，露姆无衣抱着格林，埃莉诺接受的信息有点多，一瞬间不知道说些什么。
最终还是格林打破了沉默，“咳咳，我可以解释的。”
“不不不……不用解释的！
我不会说出去的，我绝对不会知道你的任何行动计划或者安排什么的！”
格林：“其实不是什么安排，只是一个实验而已。”
埃莉诺：“实验？”
难道是某种少女和史莱姆的邪恶实验？天啊，她会不会被杀人灭口啊？要不……再保证一下？保证有用吗？可是不保证又能怎么办呢？
啊，不行，刚刚讲了那么多话，已经是极限了。
埃莉诺眼神忽明忽暗，种种可能出现在她的脑海里，埃莉诺感觉自己的脑子有点不够用了。
好可怕的压迫感，我感觉自己要窒息了……
格林：……
这女人是怎么了？紧张到忘记呼吸了？
为了解救埃莉诺，格林抓起来了一把泥土快速混合粘液成一个球，然后轻轻砸向了埃莉诺。
“哎呀！”
埃莉诺摸了摸发疼的脑袋，似乎冷静下来了，接着又快速说道：“我真的不是有意知道你的实验的，求求你了，不要杀我！
杀了我的话，我爸爸妈妈还有姐姐会伤心的，他们还会花好多好多钱去找别人逮捕你的。
补药沙窝啊！”
格林：“你这是在用你父母威胁我吗？”
content_en:
Eleanor would be so nervous around strangers that she would be speechless.
In modern terms, it is social terror.
She was not like this from the beginning. She was originally a normal child, but she lacked communication with her friends when she was growing up.
Then it evolved into feeling tired of communicating with strangers, and now I have begun to have some social anxiety.
But judging from the fact that she can explore dungeons with her friends, Eleanor's social fear has not yet reached a terrible level.
After Eleanor adjusted her condition, Karls, who had been impatient for a long time, immediately went to the dungeon.
The original arrangement was for Karls to determine the number of monsters and Eleanor to draw a schematic diagram of the dungeon structure.
It could be completed quickly by two people, but they discovered something strange: the number of monsters was smaller than the normal range.
This is not a good thing.
Either a huge amount of devouring behavior occurred among the monsters, or someone was killing monsters in large numbers.
The former indicates that some kind of high-level monster has been generated, and the latter indicates that there is a high-risk existence here.
No matter which one it is, there is a lot of danger for them.
Eleanor immediately suggested returning to the academy, and after checking the level of the monsters, Kars believed that they could handle even higher-level monsters.
So the two had a dispute. It is not very accurate to say that it was a dispute. After all, Eleanor's character would not quarrel with others.
Mainly Carls was arguing that it would be a shame for him to return to school without completing his mission.
In the middle of the story, Karls decided not to waste any more words and left directly to explore alone.
Eleanor couldn't catch up, and the structure of the dungeon was not yet explored, so the two soon lost track of each other.
Eleanor had no choice but to look for an exit and prepare to seek reinforcements.
Then she heard a human voice, shouting excitedly "Changed!"
"Finally changed!"
something.
Then there is the current situation: Green is holding Lum and looking at Eleanor, Rum is holding Green without clothes, and Eleanor has received a lot of information, and she doesn't know what to say for a moment.
In the end, Green broke the silence, "Ahem, I can explain."
"No, no, no... no need to explain!
I won't tell anyone, I will never know any of your action plans or arrangements! "
Green: "Actually, it's not an arrangement, it's just an experiment."
Eleanor: "Experiment?"
Could it be some kind of evil experiment between girls and slimes? Oh my God, will she be killed and silenced? How about... another guarantee? Is it guaranteed to work? But what can we do if there is no guarantee?
Ah, no, I just said so much, it’s already the limit.
Eleanor's eyes flickered, and all kinds of possibilities appeared in her mind. Eleanor felt that her brain was a little insufficient.
What a terrible sense of oppression, I feel like I'm suffocating...
Green: ...
What's wrong with this woman? So nervous that you forget to breathe?
In order to free Eleanor, Green grabbed a handful of dirt and quickly mixed the slime into a ball, then lightly smashed it into Eleanor.
"Ouch!"
Eleanor touched her aching head and seemed to calm down, then quickly said: "I really didn't mean to know about your experiment, please, don't kill me!
If you kill me, my parents, mom, and sister will be sad, and they will spend a lot of money to find others to arrest you.
Tonic Sand Nest! "
Green: "Are you threatening me with your parents?"
